title: Cepo stability markers
background: Selom Cepo ranks cell-type markers by differential stability — genes that are highly AND stably expressed within a type versus the rest (Kim et al. 2021). A clean-room Python reimplementation, since the reference implementation (PYangLab/Cepo) is R-only; catches identity genes that mean-difference tests miss.

references.title: Uncovering cell identity through differential stability with Cepo
references.authors: Kim HJ, Wang K, Chen C, et al.
references.note: Clean-room Python reimplementation — algorithm from the paper; no upstream Python port.

references.title: PYangLab/Cepo — reference R implementation
references.note: MIT-licensed R package; Selom's reimplementation is validated against its output.

catalog.summary: Cepo differential-stability cell-type markers — genes that are highly AND stably expressed within a type vs. the rest. Clean-room Python reimplementation (no upstream Python port); catches identity genes mean-difference tests miss.
